item.ember_raft.hook.tooltip: Right-click to throw the hook and pull floating debris in

msg.ember_raft.no_ocean: No ocean found - the raft appeared right here.

msg.ember_raft.anchor.up: Anchor raised - the raft drifts again.
msg.ember_raft.island: The raft has drifted to an island!
msg.ember_raft.island_supplies: Supplies are lying on the shore - pick them up with RMB.
